gap._description: Confirmed missing emissions (probe-verified against the real WASM)

gaps.missing: import edges mislabeled usage_contextual instead of import_based — the classifier's references branch checks isImport but TS import edges are the dedicated 'imports' kind, which falls through to the usage_contextual default (the JVM-family finding, kotlin K8 / scala G1 analog)
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (typescript/import-edges) + mutants typescript/reclassify-import-tier and typescript/drop-import-edges CAUGHT (2026-08-27). The dedicated 'imports' kind now classifies as import_based (classifier isImport branch extended), matching kotlin K8 / scala G1.

gaps.missing: type alias RHS references lost — type Fn = (a: Id) => Id, type Pair = [Id, Id], type Rec = { next?: Rec } emit the Fn/Pair/Rec symbols but NO references to the RHS types (Id, Rec self-ref)
gaps.evidence: probe: only 'global --references--> Id/Rec' from const annotations; nothing from the aliases
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (typescript/type-alias-refs) + mutant typescript/drop-type-alias-refs CAUGHT (2026-08-27). type_alias_declaration RHS now emits type_alias references to the referenced types (param, return, tuple elements, self-refs).

gaps.missing: string interpolation `got ${x}` emits no Uses on x (kotlin K4 / scala G4 analog)
gaps.evidence: probe: template_string with template_substitution children, zero uses edges
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (typescript/interp-uses) + mutant typescript/drop-expression-uses CAUGHT (2026-08-27). template_substitution identifiers now emit Uses (isTemplateInterpolation), matching kotlin K4 / scala G4.

gaps.missing: field-access Uses missing — this.h.value reads AND writes emit no Uses on the receiver h (scala G8 analog; only the call this.h.work() fires)
gaps.evidence: probe: this.h.value / this.h.value = 2 / const x = this.h.value -> no uses edge on h
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (typescript/field-uses) + mutant typescript/drop-expression-uses CAUGHT (2026-08-27). member_expression/subscript_expression reads AND writes now emit Uses on the accessed member (isFieldAccess), matching scala G8.

gaps.missing: cfg satisfies Config emits no reference to Config — the satisfies target type is dropped
gaps.evidence: probe: const ok = cfg satisfies Config -> no Config reference (only the const annotation's)
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (typescript/satisfies-ref) + mutant typescript/drop-satisfies-refs CAUGHT (2026-08-27). satisfies_expression now emits a satisfies_target reference to the asserted type.

gaps.missing: destructured locals colliding with property names produce FALSE references — const { name } = u inside main emits main --references--> name targeting User.name property (scope-blind name matching)
gaps.evidence: probe: interface User { name: string } + const { name, age } = u in main -> main --references--> name (false)
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (typescript/destructure-scope) + mutant typescript/reintroduce-shadowed-false-refs CAUGHT (2026-08-27). Function-body destructured locals shadow same-named properties — the scope-blind reference is suppressed (module-level destructured names remain symbols).

gaps.missing: dynamic import() — import('./lazy') captures the module in the imports array but emits NO imports relationship edge (and a spurious calls edge to 'import')
gaps.evidence: probe: const dyn = await import('./dynamic') -> imports array has ./dynamic, no imports edge; (script) --calls--> import
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (typescript/dynamic-import) + mutants typescript/drop-import-edges and typescript/reclassify-import-tier CAUGHT (2026-08-27). Dynamic import('./lazy') now emits an imports edge (module:item), and the spurious calls -> import edge is suppressed.

gaps.missing: <Foo>x type assertions emit no cast_target reference (as_expression works; the angle-bracket form is unhandled)
gaps.evidence: probe: const a = <Foo>bar -> no reference to Foo
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (typescript/type-assertion) + mutants typescript/drop-cast-assertion-refs and typescript/drop-declared-types CAUGHT (2026-08-27). Angle-bracket <Foo>x assertions now emit cast_target like as Foo.

gaps.missing: f<Baz>(x) generic call type arguments emit no reference to Baz (instantiation_expression unhandled by the type walk)
gaps.evidence: probe: const b = f<Baz>(qux) -> only (script) --calls--> f, no Baz reference
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (typescript/instantiation-refs) + mutant typescript/drop-type-argument-refs CAUGHT (2026-08-27). f<Baz>(x) parses as call_expression with a type_arguments child (no instantiation_expression node) — hooking type_arguments itself emits type_argument references for both call and standalone shapes.

decisions.question: tsx/JSX dialect: the analyzer handles jsx nodes (probe-verified with tree-sitter-tsx.wasm: <Button> emits uses, JSX components detected) but the completeness gate enumerates the typescript wasm (191 types) — the 13 jsx types live in the tsx grammar (382 types) and never appear in the gate's node list. Recommend: declare the jsx types as handled_verified via the tsx dialect with a dedicated tsx-wasm inventory annex, OR declared limitation (JSX handled, dialect not independently gated).
decisions.resolution: RULED — tsx/JSX dialect HANDLED_VERIFIED (2026-08-27): the analyzer handles jsx nodes (probe-verified with the tsx wasm: <Button> -> uses). The 13 jsx types live in the tsx grammar (382 types), which the gate's nodeTypeIsNamed enumeration (typescript wasm, 191) never sees — declared handled via the tsx-dialect annex, not a gap.

decisions.question: visibility/modifiers: accessibility_modifier (public/private/protected) is extracted to symbol visibility; override_modifier is a no-op flag. Recommend: declare handled (visibility pinned via existing fixtures), no symbol payload for override.
decisions.resolution: RULED — DECLARED LIMITATION (2026-08-27): visibility is extracted to the symbol payload (pinned by typescript/visibility-payload); the override_modifier is a no-op flag (no semantic emission).

decisions.question: non-null assertion x! — an expression operator, no emission. Recommend: internal_silent (consistent with kotlin/scala operator rulings).
decisions.resolution: RULED — INTERNAL SILENT (2026-08-27): non-null assertion x! emits nothing — expression operator with no symbol/relationship semantics (kotlin/scala operator ruling consistency).

decisions.question: Glimmer/Ember templates: the grammar declares them but the analyzer ignores them. Recommend: internal_silent (out of scope, consistent with scala XML-literal ruling).
decisions.resolution: RULED — INTERNAL SILENT (2026-08-27): Glimmer/Ember templates are declared by the grammar but ignored by the analyzer (scala XML-literal consistency).

decisions.question: legacy/rare type nodes (statement_identifier, this_type) — structure-only or handled by recursion. Recommend: internal_silent.
decisions.resolution: RULED — INTERNAL SILENT (2026-08-27): legacy statement_identifier / this_type nodes are structure-only with no emission.

decisions.question: [key]: value computed names — recursed generically, symbols emit from the value expression. Recommend: internal_silent (no dedicated symbol for the computed name itself).
decisions.resolution: RULED — INTERNAL SILENT (2026-08-27): computed_property_name is recursed generically; no dedicated symbol emission.
